chunks: For them is good news in the life of the world and in the life to come. There is no changing the words of God. That will be the great triumph.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'good news in the life of the world and the Hereafter' in Surah Yunus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to mean that the 'good news' in this life refers to the spiritual tranquility and victory of the faithful (and their Imams) even amidst trials, while the Hereafter refers to the ultimate reward. The phrase 'immutability of God's words' underscores the reliability of divine promises, a concept central to Shia theology regarding the infallibility of the Ahl al-Bayt as the living embodiment of these promises. Thus, true success is defined not merely by material gain but by steadfast adherence to divine guidance.
